copy.headline: You’re believing alone, but the kingdom never walks solo
copy.subhead: A discipleship community where faith is shared, not carried in silence
copy.hook: Do you hear God’s voice but find no ears beside you?
copy.body: Pastor Curtis and Pastor Tammy have gathered a group that walks the Word together. In this community you will study Scripture, pray, and hold each other accountable. The loneliness ends when you sit at the same table as believers who speak the same truth. Click to see who’s waiting.
